falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Understanding may precede mastery.

falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Learning does not always imply mastery.

falseSynonyms.zh: 練習不等於 master practice 是過程；master 是達成的熟練結果。

falseSynonyms.zh: 知道不等於精通 know 可只表示知道事實或熟悉資訊。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Knowing is broader and often weaker.

falseSynonyms.zh: 只表示上手，不等於完全精通 它通常是初步掌握操作方法。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Getting the hang of something is an early-stage competence.

falseSynonyms.zh: 只在打磨技能 sense 接近 perfect 通常假設已有基礎，再把技能提升至更高標準。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Perfecting presupposes an existing skill.

falseSynonyms.zh: 詞性陷阱 master 可作動詞；mastery 是名詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Master is a verb here; mastery is the noun.
